name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix playback for federated items lacking a configured remote UserId: PlaybackInfo now falls back to the remote's first user automatically (previously it returned null, so media sources carried no Container/MediaStreams and every client reported 'Unable to find a valid media source to play'). Adds logs to confirm stream info is resolved.
